label: Hide personal data
description: Finds personal data (emails, phone and card numbers, IBANs, IP addresses, US social security numbers, your own patterns) in a data field and hides it, flags it or stops the run. Lists what kinds it found, never the values.

outputs.name: next
outputs.description: Where to go after the check: connect the next step, or Finish.

input.title: Text to check
input.description: The data field to check. For the conversation (messages) the newest message is checked.

on_fail.title: When it fails
on_fail.description: redact = hide what was found and carry on; flag = change nothing and save the verdict; stop = end the run with an error.

flag_output.title: Save yes/no in
flag_output.description: Optional: a true/false field that is true when the check fails. Branch on it with Choose a path, e.g. state.flagged == true.

report_output.title: Save the details in
report_output.description: Optional: a field that receives what was found and why (never the personal data itself).

types.title: What to look for
types.description: email, phone, credit_card (checked with the Luhn test), iban, ip_address, us_ssn.

custom_patterns.title: Your own patterns
custom_patterns.description: Optional regular expressions for your own kinds of personal data, e.g. AB-\d{6} for order ids.

strategy.title: How to hide it
strategy.description: redact = [REDACTED_EMAIL]; mask = keep the last 4 characters (****-1111); hash = a short fingerprint, the same for the same value.

output.title: Save the cleaned text in
output.description: Optional: leave empty to clean the field in place (the message itself, for messages).
